memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Joseph said to them, 'It is just as I told you: You are spies! And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here. Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!' And he put them all in custody for three days." - Gen 42:14-17 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joseph sets a test, insisting that the brothers must bring their youngest brother to prove their honesty, and he puts them all in custody for three days. To the brothers, this must have seemed like sheer cruelty from a suspicious foreign ruler. But Joseph had a purpose. He wanted to see their hearts — and especially how they would treat Benjamin, the new favored youngest son. Would they abandon him as they had abandoned Joseph, or had they truly changed?

Notice the three days in custody. The brothers, who had once thrown Joseph into a pit and left him in captivity, now find themselves in captivity. For three days they sit with their thoughts, with time to reflect — and as the next verses show, their consciences begin to stir. God was using this hard experience to bring long-buried sin to the surface.

There is a principle here worth remembering. God sometimes allows us to experience a taste of what we have done to others, or to sit in difficult circumstances that give our conscience room to work. These are not merely punishments; they are opportunities for reflection, repentance, and change.

If God has allowed you a hard, confining season, ask what He might be doing in it. Sometimes He confines us not to crush us, but to give us space to reflect, to face what we have avoided, and to be changed. Use the "three days" well.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Have I ever tasted what I once did to others?
2. Is God using a hard season to give my conscience room to work?
3. What might God want me to reflect on and face right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when You allow me hard or confining seasons, help me to use them well. Give my conscience room to work, show me what I need to face, and change me by Your grace. Amen.
